description:
Do you want to be an affiliate marketer for a brand that gives back to US veterans? We've got you!

HYDR8™is an alkaline bottled water brand that provides consumers an optimal hydration experience while supporting programs and services for US veterans and their famlies.

HYDR8 water first undergoes a rigorous multiple-step purification method before being infused with proprietary formulation of ionized minerals. This creates a stable, high pH ensuring you are getting clean, great-tasting alkaline water with hydration you can trust.

Our entire HYDR8 line will be focused on giving back through charitable giving, because social spirit is part of the ethos of the HYDR8 US company. We are dedicated to social responsibility, along with offering premium hydration products at affordable prices. 

Please join us as we drink up & give back! We need YOU!
